Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Task Governance: Conventions, Validation & Lifecycle
Content:
## Overview

All tasks live in Data/Tasks/*.json. These conventions prevent data integrity issues across agent and human workflows.

## Schema Contract

Every task JSON file must conform to:
- Required fields: id, key, title, status, type, priority, description, createdAtUtc, updatedAtUtc, revision
- Field casing: camelCase (id, key, title, status, description, etc.)
- ID format: id = "tsk-XXXX-descriptive-slug" matching the filename. key = "TSK-XXXX"
- New tasks: id must match ^tsk-\d{4}-[a-z0-9-]+$. key must match ^TSK-\d{4}$

## Allowed Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|--------|---------|
| Backlog | Not yet started, awaiting prioritization |
| Ready | Prioritized and scoped, ready to begin |
| InProgress | Actively being worked on |
| Blocked | Cannot proceed; reason documented in comments |
| Done | Complete with evidence comment |
| Archived | Superseded or no longer relevant; rationale documented |
| Rejected | Considered and declined; rationale documented |

No other status values permitted. Non-standard statuses must be migrated to the canonical set.

## Priority Values

Only Critical, High, Medium, Low are permitted. Priority labels (p0, p1, P0) are not allowed in the labels array.

## Labels

Lowercase with hyphen-separated words. Prefix conventions:
- sprint-XX: sprint association (e.g. sprint-53)
- domain:xxx: domain area (e.g. domain:mineflayer, domain:chat)
- type:xxx: classification (e.g. type:bug, type:refactor, type:testing)
Priority codes NOT allowed as labels. Duplicate casing variants not permitted.

## Lifecycle

1. Creation: Use memorysmith_task_create MCP tool or copy validated template
2. Validation: Always run Test-TaskRecords.ps1 after creation or mutation
3. Done transition: Requires evidence comment with file paths, test results, or sprint handoff reference
4. Unique keys: Check for existing keys before creating new tasks

## Validation

Script: pwsh ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1
Checks: valid JSON, allowed statuses, allowed priorities, unique keys, no orphan .md files, no embedded control characters
CI step in .github/workflows/ci.yml runs same validation on every push touching Data/Tasks/
